entries.reason: Fact-preserving motion-language mount. `classical/state-estimation` gained two sentences and one mount after the step-through fusion demo: the sentences bridge from the stepped scene to a cinematic clip of the same seeded filter (the clip plays step 0 to step 240 and the uncertainty band widens across dropouts and tightens on readings), and the mount is the `Clip` instrument. The clip replays the identical `lib/kalman.ts` model, seed and numbers the article and the live scene already show; no claim, citation, number, heading, link or reference changed. Added by the motion-language clip pipeline (motion-clips.json `kalman-episode`).

The prose states only what the shipped clip shows.

entries.reason: Fact-preserving accessible-name addition in a new component. `components/motion/clip.tsx` labels its instrument frame region `Cinematic clip: ` followed by the clip title from motion-clips.json (currently `One Kalman filter, a whole run`), so the mounted video instrument is announced as the region it is. The title restates what the frame holds; nothing else on any page changed. Added by the motion-language clip pipeline.

entries.reason: Fact-preserving accessible-name addition in a new component. The name restates facts the frame already prints; nothing else changed. Added by the motion-language clip pipeline.

LinearizationGap (state estimation, new) is a tangent-rule stand: a one-joint arm swings over an upright protractor, its stylus riding in a groove engraved in the face at the arm's length, the hand's true path, and a steel rule across the top touches the groove at the estimate, the straight line the extended Kalman filter puts in the curve's place. A cursor on the rule goes where the straight line puts the hand for the arm's angle and carries a dial gauge: its plunger reaches down to the arm's tip, so the plunger's length is the miss, marked every centimetre, and the dial turns once for 15 cm, so at the opening spread it reads the 6.8 cm the readout prints; plunger and needle are the one lit assembly. The miss is about four times as large for twice the spread. The protractor carries degree graduations from its rim, guide lines every fifteen degrees and a maker's plate. The spread slider (5 to 40 degrees either side of the estimate, opening at 30) moves two pairs of stops, one on the rim and one on the rule; "Swing the arm" sweeps the arm across the spread and back, and reduced motion holds it still (lib/linearization-gap.ts, the article's extended Kalman filter section: Thrun, Burgard and Fox 2005; McGee and Schmidt 1985; Dellaert and Kaess 2006; the 50 cm arm and the spreads are illustrative, the miss is that arm's exact geometry). Its source joins the interactive-sources registry (regenerated by npm run generate:brand-v2-registries), classified schematic in lib/brand-v2-interactive-data.ts; the geometry is in components/iso/figures/tangent-rule-table.ts. The drawing's accessible description (aria-describedby) is the method paragraph that explains it ("The drawing is a tangent-rule stand ..."), as for every Anatomy drawing since the accessibility gate of 2026-10-17.
